thread:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for runtime/v2 on us-west-2. 10% of traffic -> v2. config: batching=on, kernels=auto, kv_cache=enabled
oncall-bot: Paging alex (on-call). latency_slo=50ms breached for 3m, error_rate increased 0.8% -> paging
alex: saw the page, joining. any link to canary dashboard?
maria: https://redwood.hq/dashboards/canary/1769808452 - tail latency spike after 12:15 UTC. throughput drop on the v2 instances
alex: looking at logs. kernel fallback messages flooding: "kernel_select: fallback to reference_kernel" for many steps
jp: that suggests some backend kernels failed optimization path - probably a build-time mismatch. did the rollout include a kernel change?
suzanne: yes, the build included new fused attention kernel; we tested on CI but not on all instance types.
alex: canary nodes on p4de show fallback loops, concurrent batching queues piling up. seeing queuing latency in ms->s
maria: customer impact: a few heavy tenants reported timeouts and we have 2 support tickets about slow embeddings. notifying support
opsbot: runbook snippet: to kill canary traffic -> set feature-flag runtime-v2.enabled=false or rollback canary via deploy-bot
alex: I'll try kill-switch first to avoid full rollback. Maria, do you have flag control link?
maria: https://flags.redwood/runtime-v2 - toggling now
maria: toggled runtime-v2.enabled=false :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary percentage updated: v2 -> 0%. Traffic routed back to v1.
alex: verifying. metrics show request counts to v2 drop to 0 within 30s. latency tail starts to recover
jp: while traffic drains, push a small mitigation: disable batching on runtime nodes to reduce queuing pressure. set batching.policy=none for v1 and v2 pools
suzanne: applying batching override via infra API:
```
PATCH /infra/pools/us-west-2/runtime
{ "overrides": {"batching": "off"} }
```
opsbot: override applied to us-west-2 runtime pool
alex: after kill-switch + batching off, P99 latency back to baseline in ~90s. error_rate dropping. we should keep v2 disabled until kernel fix
maria: Support notified customers and opened incident ticket INC-6842, marking impacted customers and mitigation steps
jp: next steps: revert fused kernel changes, or build a compatible kernel variant for p4de. I'll bisect the kernel commits that landed in last deploy
suzanne: I'll coordinate a controlled rollback of the kernel change on a staging fleet and run extended perf tests on p4de variants
alex: handoff: I'm oncall for another 20m then handing to JP. leaving notes in thread.
alex: Handoff to jp
jp: taking over. ETA for kernel hotfix 4h, but will update every hour. If we see any residual issues, re-open paging
maria: adding post-mortem checklist: root cause hypothesis, rollout gating for kernel changes, and enforce infra matrix tests before canary
oncall-bot: Incident recorded: INC-6842, severity=high, status=mitigated, responders=[alex,jp,maria,suzanne]
alex: thanks everyone. concur we keep v2 disabled until validated. closing on-call loop.
